import os, subprocess, ctypes, torch, shutil, math
S = open('/tmp/k48d/k.cu').read()
S = S.replace('if (smem > kSmemDyn || a1 > kMaxStages || a2 > kMaxStages) return 441;', 'if (smem > kSmemDyn || a1 > kMaxStages || (mode == 1 && a2 > kMaxStages)) return 441;')
open('/tmp/k48d/k2.cu','w').write(S)
nvcc = shutil.which('nvcc') or '/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc'
r = subprocess.run([nvcc,'-O3','-std=c++17','-gencode','arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a','-shared','-Xcompiler','-fPIC','/tmp/k48d/k2.cu','-o','/tmp/k48d/k2.so','-lcuda'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('build', r.returncode, r.stderr[-800:])
from ctypes import c_void_p, c_int, POINTER
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/k48d/k2.so'); f = lib.run_k; f.restype = c_int
f.argtypes = [c_void_p, c_void_p, c_void_p, POINTER(c_void_p), c_int, c_int, c_int, c_int, c_int, c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p]
torch.manual_seed(4)
W = torch.randn(18432, 3072, device='cuda') / math.sqrt(3072); bias = torch.randn(18432, device='cuda')
prof = torch.zeros(144*8, dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
def call(emb, outs, B, nb, ks, mode, a1, a2, pf=None):
    arr = (c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
    return f(emb.data_ptr(), W.data_ptr(), bias.data_ptr(), arr, B, nb, ks, mode, a1, a2, pf.data_ptr() if pf is not None else None, torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
V = [(384,1,48,0,3,0),(384,1,48,0,3,256+3),(384,1,48,0,3,256+4),(384,1,48,0,3,256+6),(384,1,32,0,5,0),(384,1,32,0,5,256+6),(449,1,32,0,5,0),(449,1,32,0,5,256+6)]
embs = {B: torch.randn(B,3072,device='cuda') for B in set(v[0] for v in V)}
flush = torch.empty(252*1024*1024//4, device='cuda')
res = {v: [] for v in V}
for rnd in range(3):
    for v in V:
        B,nb,ks,mode,a1,a2 = v; e = embs[B]
        outs = [torch.empty(B,3072,device='cuda') for _ in range(6)]
        prof.zero_(); flush.zero_()
        s0=torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True); s1=torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
        s0.record(); rc=call(e, outs, B, nb, ks, mode, a1, a2, prof); s1.record(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        if rc: print('rc', v, rc)
        p = prof.view(144,8)[:72*nb].double().cpu(); nIt = 3072//ks
        stage = ((p[:,2]-p[:,1])/(nIt-1)).median().item()
        span = (p[:,3]-p[:,0]).median().item()
        mhz = ((p[:,3]-p[:,0])/(p[:,5]-p[:,4])*1000).median().item()
        res[v].append((stage, stage*32/ks, span, mhz, s0.elapsed_time(s1)*1000))
for v in V:
    print(v, ' | '.join(f'stg {x[0]:.0f} /32k {x[1]:.0f} span {x[2]/1e3:.1f}k {x[3]:.0f}MHz {x[4]:.1f}us' for x in res[v]))
